## Digital media fees

Traditional media: the client pays the outlet 85% directly, and zö agency bills the 15% commission plus creative.

Digital media: zö agency bills a monthly management fee, and the client's card stays on the ad account. The fee tapers with monthly spend.

| Spend up to | Fee percent | Minimum fee |
|---|---|---|
| 10000 | 20 | 2000 |
| 15000 | 18 |  |
| 20000 | 17 |  |
| 25000 | 16 |  |
| 30000 | 15 |  |
| 35000 | 14 |  |
| 40000 | 13 |  |
| 50000 | 12 |  |
| 75000 | 11 |  |
| above | 10 |  |

## Billing terms

| Name | How it bills | Terms |
|---|---|---|
| Standard 50/25/25 | 50% up front, 25% at the midpoint milestone, 25% at completion | Deposit due on receipt, before work starts. The rest Net 15. |
| Production 100 | 100% up front for print, swag and produced items | Due on receipt, before work starts. |
| Government Monthly | Last day of each month | Net 15 unless the contract sets other terms. |
| Retainer Monthly | 15th of the month before the service month | Due by the 1st of the service month. |
| Lump Sum at Completion | One invoice at approval or completion | Net 15. |

**7f.** Card payments carry a 3% fee. ACH is exempt.

**7g.** These timelines are the rule of thumb. Negotiated exceptions are fine. Name the timeline in the proposal.

**7h.** Value-based government contracts such as SCSU, Contra Costa and Sacramento bill on Government Monthly.
